inspection.method: Direct visible playback in Chrome; selected muted frames and player metadata.
inspection.coverageNote: Approximate observation points, not edit boundaries. No continuous review or spoken transcript.

observations.layout: upper graphic / lower presenter, approximately equal halves
observations.visibleEvidence: Pale yellow stage with paper/email card, colored text highlights, oversized blue magnifier, and small character. Close presenter with microphone below. Short caption straddles seam.
Paper card with highlighted writing and small red flags in upper half. Presenter remains below.
Character, message card, advert card, and rising-chart sign. Short caption below central artwork, around two-thirds frame height.
Fan of overlapping webpage/email cards over pastel stage; caption below artwork.

principles: An inspection tool and visible highlights make an abstract cleanup action concrete.
Supporting graphics can take over the frame when the explanation needs space.
Caption position follows the active layout and avoids the principal artwork.
notes: Principles are our interpretations of visible evidence. They are not claims about the creator's editing process.
